out.other_title: Debate helps non-expert LLM and human judges on QuALITY; persuasive debaters help more
out.rationale: The authors find that for Pro 1.5, when the judge is the same as the debaters, debate leads to worse judge accuracy than QA without article, and say this is similar to some of the findings reported in Fig 31 of Khan et al.; the cited passages do not show what Fig 31 reports. Both studies ask whether debate raises judge accuracy over a baseline without debate, in different settings, so SAME_QUESTION_DIFFERENT_SETTING rather than SUPPORTS. No dedicated record exists for this Khan finding, so the CORE record is used. The citing passage names the cited work; the target is the cited paper's main record, not a record of the specific result.
